caption:
we only talk about the 3 years everyone remembers.

not the 30 that came before.

if you're in your quiet years, they're not wasted. ✝

slides.text:
before anyone knew his name
there were 30 quiet years
slides.image: window light dark room stillness waiting

slides.query: how old was jesus when he started his ministry
slides.result: Luke 3:23 says Jesus was **about thirty years old** when he began his ministry.

slides.query: what did jesus do before his ministry
slides.result: In Mark 6:3 the people of his hometown call him **"the carpenter."** Ordinary work, in a small town.

slides.text:
thirty years of ordinary days
three years everyone remembers

we only post the three
nobody posts the thirty

if you're in your quiet years
they aren't wasted
slides.image: lake dock dawn new beginning clarity

slides.text:
maybe the quiet years
are where you're being built
slides.image: lone figure under light shaft water awakening grace
